name: summary-aside-shell
title: Summary aside shell
description: A two-column flow layout: the steps on the left and a sticky summary card on the right, which becomes a bottom bar with a sheet on phones.
docs: Put the steps or the form in children, the order, booking or quote in summary, and give the total already formatted (the shell does no arithmetic). action is the primary button: it is shown in the card, in the bottom bar and in the sheet, so give it form="your-form-id" and no id of its own. From lg the summary is a 22rem card that sticks under the header while the steps scroll; below lg a bar fixed to the bottom shows the total, the action and a Show summary button that opens the whole summary in a bottom sheet. The bar and the sheet respect the safe-area insets, and the steps get matching bottom padding so the bar never covers the last field. Changes of the total are announced politely. The steps are the main landmark (pass mainId when the page already uses id=main) and the card is a complementary one. header is a sticky bar for your mark and a note about secure payment; totalNote adds a line under the total, labels translates the words. The page scrolls like a normal page.
